Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Rahul Pandey, Advocate For the State : Mr. V. K. Vashistha, Spl.P.P
---------
03/Dated: 17th January, 2024
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 23.05.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with POCSO Case No.101 of 2022, arising out of Nagri P.S. Case No.78 of 2022,
pending in the court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner - IV -cum- Spl. Judge - POCSO,
Ranchi.
3. It appears that the applicant has been made an accused for committing the offence under Section 376G of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/ 6 of the POCSO Act.
The charge-sheet has been submitted under Sections 376DA/ 376(3) of the I.P.C and Sections 4/ 6 of the POCSO Act.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that that the police has doubted the story of the victim.
It is a false Ramchandra Gope vs The State Of Jharkhand .....

On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that the victim has identified this applicant and supported the allegation in her deposition.
6. Considering the deposition of the victim, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant stands rejected.
7. However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
